**- Anonymous post for someone else -**

Hi all!

We are same-sex couple. My wife and I are trying to start the fertility process, but she will be the one carrying and she is not Israeli. We can't seem to get our feet in the door anywhere because she doesn't have an Israeli ID number to schedule the appointment. We've managed to get some things done (like blood work and a follicular ultrasound) but to move forward we have no idea what else to do next. We don't want to make an appointment with a fertility/IVF doctor who isn't familiar with the process when the person carrying as we have already tried that and it led us nowhere.

Has anybody successfully done this? Any help/guidance would be greatly appreciated.
